title: Kenworth T909 Custom Built FUPS Compliant Road Train Hi-tensile Aluminium Bullbar #91
description: Kenworth, T900, T909, T950, FUPS compliant Custom Built 5 post Road Train high tensile polished aluminium Bullbar. 88mm dia pipe with 76mm dia pipe, 100mm dia pipe available. All cross pipes are one piece 6mm wall high tensile pipe, no but welds. Custom built 450mm deep main channel with lower skirt. Heavy duty steel backing plate with tow pin and lift assist spring. High tensile box uprights with plus combination Indicator, Parking and Daylight Running LED lights fitted to the outer posts. Flip over Road Train signs with heavy duty storage bag. Wombat Flap plus mudflap mounts. Driving light mounts fitted to lower bar. Bull bar can be custom built to your requirements.
